title: Non gazetted cadre employees’ chain hunger strike begins at GMC Rajouri

ai.summary: Non-gazetted cadre employees at five new Jammu and Kashmir government medical colleges began an eighth-day chain hunger strike demanding notification of their cadre-specific recruitment rules, which they say has left their career progression uncertain.

facts.claim: non-gazetted cadre employees of Government Medical College (GMC) Rajouri launched a chain hunger strike alongside their ongoing agitation
facts.quote: The non-gazetted cadre employees of Government Medical College (GMC) Rajouri launched a chain hunger strike alongside their ongoing agitation, which entered its eighth consecutive day on Monday, November 23, 2026.

facts.claim: agitation entered its eighth consecutive day on Monday, November 23, 2026
facts.quote: The non-gazetted cadre employees of Government Medical College (GMC) Rajouri launched a chain hunger strike alongside their ongoing agitation, which entered its eighth consecutive day on Monday, November 23, 2026.

facts.claim: agitation is being held across all five newly established Government Medical Colleges of Jammu and Kashmir
facts.quote: The agitation is being held across all five newly established Government Medical Colleges of Jammu and Kashmir, where employees are demanding notification of their cadre-specific recruitment rules.

facts.claim: employees are demanding notification of their cadre-specific recruitment rules
facts.quote: The agitation is being held across all five newly established Government Medical Colleges of Jammu and Kashmir, where employees are demanding notification of their cadre-specific recruitment rules.

facts.claim: despite these medical colleges having been functional for the past seven to eight years, their recruitment rules were not notified
facts.quote: The protesting employees said that despite these medical colleges having been functional for the past seven to eight years, their recruitment rules were not notified.

facts.claim: the absence of these rules left employees without clear avenues for career progression and promotion
facts.quote: They alleged that the absence of these rules left employees without clear avenues for career progression and promotion.

facts.claim: employees are pressing the Jammu and Kashmir government to notify the recruitment rules
facts.quote: The employees are pressing the Jammu and Kashmir government to notify the recruitment rules, stating that their professional future remains uncertain in the absence of a proper framework.

facts.claim: the hunger strike would continue alongside the ongoing agitation until the government notified their recruitment rules
facts.quote: At GMC Rajouri, two employees sat on a chain hunger strike on Monday as part of the intensified protest. The employees said the hunger strike would continue alongside the ongoing agitation until the government notified their recruitment rules.
